About DroneDeploy DroneDeploy powers field teams with robotics and AI. As the only reality capture platform that combines robotic automation, AI agents, and a truly unified system, DroneDeploy allows critical industries to operate with speed and confidence.

From construction and energy to agriculture, the world’s largest companies use DroneDeploy to simplify field operations, improve safety, and make smarter decisions, faster.

By combining aerial drones, 360 and fixed cameras, ground robots and proprietary AI, we’re bringing the power of automation and visual intelligence to all stakeholders, from the field to the boardroom. At DroneDeploy , we thrive in a mostly remote-first culture rooted in innovation and impact.

We’ve been recognized as a Best Place to Work in the SF Bay Area and named one of America’s Great Places to Work—but what truly sets us apart is the experience you gain: solving real-world challenges with cutting-edge technology, surrounded by teammates who are as passionate as they are supportive.

Our team is bold, mission-driven, and building something that matters. We foster a culture where a variety of perspectives drive smart decisions, and where growth—both personal and professional—is part of the journey.

Whether it’s flexible schedules, family-friendly benefits, or our strong track record of internal promotions, we invest in people as much as we do in product. If you’re looking to be part of something ambitious, authentic, and transformative, you’ll find your place at DroneDeploy .

This is an evergreen posting intended to collect interest from qualified candidates. It does not indicate that a specific position is currently open. Submitting your application is an expression of interest for future all Account Executive level opportunities at DroneDeploy .

Role Overview As an Account Executive, you will be a partner to organizations across our core industries, including Architecture, Engineering & Construction (AEC), Energy, and emerging markets. You will own a defined territory and/or portfolio of accounts, with a mandate to drive both expansion within existing customers and net‑new business.

This is a high‑impact, high‑autonomy role: you will shape account strategy, build stakeholder relationships, and deliver innovative solutions that redefine what’s possible in reality capture and field operations technology.

Beyond consistent quota attainment, success means navigating complex, consultative sales cycles, influencing multi‑stakeholder organizations, and leveraging cutting‑edge technology to drive measurable, real‑world outcomes. Work Environment > Work Model: Remote role based in the U.S.

(based within your assigned region and within reasonable proximity to a major airport). > Work Hours: Operate during standard business hours in your local time zone. > Work Travel: Be in the field 25%-50% of the time for client meetings, prospect visits, and company events; domestic travel is required, with occasional international travel as needed.

Responsibilities: Own and Drive Growth: Take ownership of your territory or book of business, developing and executing account strategies that deliver measurable revenue growth across expansion and new logo acquisition.

Account Leadership: Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders ranging from project leaders to C‑level executives, uncovering business challenges and architecting tailored solutions that maximize value and impact.

Autonomous Decision-Making: Exercise independent judgment in prioritizing opportunities, structuring deals, and navigating complex negotiations. You will have the latitude to make critical decisions that shape both customer outcomes and DroneDeploy ’s market position.

Full Sales Lifecycle: Lead the entire customer journey—from prospecting and discovery through solution design, closing, onboarding, and ongoing expansion. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and Product teams to deliver seamless, high-value experiences for your clients.

Market Intelligence: Stay ahead of industry and technology trends in reality capture, AI, and field operations, positioning DroneDeploy as the partner of choice for digital transformation across AEC, Energy, and emerging industries.

Outcome Focus: Consistently achieve or exceed quota, maintaining a robust 120-day rolling forecast and delivering results that move the needle for both your clients and DroneDeploy . Requirements: We are open to sales professionals across multiple segments, including High Velocity, Mid-Market and Enterprise.

Ideal candidates bring 1 to 7+ years of full-cycle, quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales experience, with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets. Experience selling into AEC, Energy, or other field-based or emerging industries is strongly valued.

Demonstrated ability to operate with autonomy, make high-stakes decisions, and deliver results in ambiguous or rapidly evolving environments. Consultative, solution-oriented approach—skilled at uncovering needs, building consensus, and driving value at every stage of the sales cycle. Exceptional communication, negotiation, and executive presence.

Proficiency with Salesforce, Outreach, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and an ability to quickly adopt new sales and AI tools. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Why Join DroneDeploy ? Impact: Shape the future of construction technology and leave your mark on iconic projects worldwide.

Autonomy: Be trusted to make strategic decisions, and drive outcomes that matter. Growth: Influence the rollout of new AI products and emerging technologies. Culture: Join a collaborative team that values innovation, initiative, and continuous learning. Flexibility: Work remotely, with the opportunity to be in the field 50%+.

Employee Offerings & Benefits (Benefits may vary by location and role) These are just some of the perks you'll enjoy—there's more to discover once you join us! Culture of Innovation & Collaboration – Thrive in an environment that values creativity and teamwork.

Drone Certification – Get certified and gain unique, hands-on skills with our full backing. Flexible Work Arrangements – Enjoy autonomy with remote-first options and schedule flexibility. Paid Family Leave – Take the time you need to support your family during life’s most important moments.

Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage – Plans designed to support your well-being. Career & Growth Development – Build new skills and unlock opportunities through continuous learning. Flexible PTO – Take time off when you need it to recharge—we trust you to manage your time well. Employee Referral Bonus – Know someone great?

Refer them and earn a bonus when they join our team. ---- DroneDeploy is an equal opportunity employer. All DroneDeploy employees are responsible for protecting the company and customer data by following information security policies and procedures.

You are a Senior Account Executive at Patterno. You own complex deals end-to-end, from discovery to closed-won, and you help turn a working motion into a predictable, scalable revenue engine.
You run sharp discovery, lead multi-stakeholder processes, and drive executive-level outcomes. You generate pipeline, build trust with senior stakeholders, and raise the bar on how we sell—especially for enterprise contracts.
What success looks like (first 90 days)
Build a strong pipeline across inbound, partner signals, and outbound; run tight next steps and mutual action plans
Establish a repeatable cadence: CRM hygiene, pipeline reviews, and accurate forecasting you can defend
Turn deal learnings into scalable assets: ICP refinement, objection handling, competitive intel, and messaging that converts
Aufgaben

Own the full sales cycle from discovery to closed-won across mid-market and enterprise-style buying committees
Navigate procurement, legal, and compliance-heavy processes and keep momentum through complex deal cycles
Drive clear next steps and timelines, manage mutual action plans, and keep momentum through complex sales processes
Lead late-stage deal strategy (qualification, value framing, negotiation, close plans) and drive clean execution
Partner with the founders on positioning, messaging, and pricing. Turn what you learn in deals into better GTM materials
Keep a clean CRM, forecast accurately, and make performance visible through simple reporting
Generate your own pipeline and help define the outbound + inbound operating system as the team scales
Feed market insights back to the product team. Every deal is product input and competitive intelligence
Qualifikation

Must-haves
German + English fluency
4–7+ years in B2B sales with measurable results (quota attainment, win rate, multi-stakeholder deal velocity, and enterprise deal size)
You’ve done both SDR work and full-cycle AE closing (you can prospect and you can close)
Strong track record selling enterprise / complex contracts and navigating procurement-heavy environments
Strong commercial judgment: you qualify hard, push for clarity, and can say no to bad-fit deals
Tool- and process-driven: you run a clean CRM, build repeatable workflows, and use modern tools (including AI) to automate busywork
Numbers-first operator: you manage your funnel by conversion, cycle length, and pipeline coverage
Nice-to-haves
B2B SaaS background (or similar high-velocity sales environment)
Experience selling into procurement-heavy or compliance-driven buying committees
Experience in an early-stage or fast-scaling environment (build while you sell)
You might be a fit if you
Love turning a strong discovery call into a structured process that closes
Enjoy working in ambiguity and improving the system while executing on it
Want to be part of building a sales engine, not just inheriting someone else’s playbook
Are hungry for ownership and not interested in waiting for permission
Care about winning but stay humble about what you don’t know yet
Have something outside of work that shows you don’t do things halfway, whether that’s competitive sports, a side project, or something completely different
Want to be a senior closer and help build a world-class sales machine

High ownership over pipeline, deals, and the way we sell
Direct exposure to the founders’ deal strategy, product direction, and market positioning
Clear OTE structure + meaningful upside (uncapped); calibrated for top performance
AI-native sales stack. You’ll work with the best tools from day one
A front-row seat to scaling a company in a massive, underdigitized market
We’re past the demo stage. Patterno is live with large customers in one of Europe’s most critical and most underdigitized markets, and the motion is working. Demand is there; now it’s about scaling execution with speed and precision. Join at the scale-up moment, own high-stakes deals, and help turn a proven wedge into the go-to platform for winning public contracts.
We envision a world where every relevant tender reaches the right company at the right time, where procurement intelligence is no longer locked behind manual research and outdated portals.

About commercetools
Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.
Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together they are the engine of commerce innovation today.
At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.
Here the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce, but to build your own.

As our Senior Strategic Account Executive , you will be responsible for securing and expanding the largest and most transformative enterprise clients of commercetools in our core verticals including retail and B2B.

You will lead C-suite engagements, navigate multi-year digital transformation initiatives, and close complex, multi-million dollar platform deals that define commercetools’ market leadership.

This is a high impact, quota carrying role reserved for top-performing enterprise salespeople with the DNA for large scale clients, ensuring we delight our customers, retain and grow our business together with them.
You are viewed as a market influencer, strategic advisor, and deal orchestrator - responsible not only for revenue generation, but for accelerating commercetools dominance in the enterprise commerce platform category.
Own and grow a portfolio of the highest-value retail and CPG strategic enterprise accounts.
Serve as the primary point of contact for these accounts from an sales and account management perspective, and in tight collaboration with our CS (customer success) team and orchestrating the executive relationships as well as all of commercetools in the pursuit of maximizing the value of the relationship with these clients for both parties
Lead complex, multi-threaded sales cycles involving CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CMOs, CFOs, and their teams.
Solution Differentiation & Technical Collaboration: Articulate commercetools' capabilities and differentiation clearly. Collaborate with solutions consultants to engage technical teams effectively.
Value: Partner tightly with the value engineering team to ensure we are focused on outcomes for our customers, and drive our top line growth with cross and up-sell campaigns.
Organizational sales orchestration: Manage the complex sales process inclusive of MEDDPICC, notably the relationships at these clients (Champions, EBs, influencers and others)
Partnering: Collaborate with our ISVs and SIs to ensure the successes noted above.
Develop tailored account plans for each client and manage the cadence for continuous execution.
Orchestrate internal and external resources including alliances, professional services, product leadership, and GSI’s to craft enterprise transformation roadmaps.
Influence digital strategy at the board and executive level; position commercetools as an innovation partner rather than a vendor.
Close multi-year, multi-solution platform agreements that drive long-term value realization across multiple lines of business, regions, and brands. Consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales quotas.
Track, analyze, and report on key account metrics, such as revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and project delivery.
What Sets You Apart
You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.
Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work.
